title: 🎟️ Portland Day 6 · Orientation + Haystack Rock walk
location: Haystack Rock, Tolovana Beach State Recreation Site
description:
Iconic Cannon Beach sea-stack exploration.
What to see: 235-foot Haystack Rock visible from the beach.
Tide pools: Low tide is essential for exploring tide pools around the base of the rock. Check NOAA tide times for November 6, 2026 before the trip at noaa.gov or tide-forecast.com. Optimal window usually a couple hours before/after the lowest tide.
What to bring: Layers (coastal wind), water, snacks, camera.
Warnings: Lifeguards and patrol trucks monitor the area; stay off exposed rocks to protect tide-pool ecosystems.
Estimated cost: Free.
Location: Haystack Rock, Tolovana Beach State Recreation Site
Website: https://www.cannonbeach.org/things-to-do/beaches-and-parks/haystack-rock/
Payment: No admission; public land open 24/7
Duration: 180 min.
